origin.description: Whether stdout should emit OSC 8 hyperlinks.
origin.details: crayon.hyperlink TRUE or FALSE is final. Otherwise a non-terminal is FALSE, Windows is TRUE, CI and TeamCity are FALSE, iTerm from 3.1 is TRUE, and VTE from 0.50.1 is TRUE.
origin.example:
cat(has_hyperlink(), "\n", sep="")
options(crayon.hyperlink = TRUE)
cat(has_hyperlink(), "\n", sep="")

translation.description: Whether stdout should emit OSC 8 hyperlinks.
translation.details: options(crayon.hyperlink=True) forces True, and False forces False. With the option unset, a pipe or a captured process is False. iTerm and VTE are read from TERM_PROGRAM and VTE_VERSION.
translation.example:
print("TRUE" if has_hyperlink() else "FALSE")
options(**{"crayon.hyperlink": True})
print("TRUE" if has_hyperlink() else "FALSE")
